text: 1577 adds an initial physical width of 8 px. Accepted CSS now uses inline-size:8px with margin-inline-end:-8px and a block-end offset. In this pill component, keep the logical dimension consistent with its logical overlap margins. This is a scoped layout recommendation, not a rule that all icons must have the same size. No RTL rendering or icon geometry was visually audited. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: The pill warning icon’s dimension follows its logical overlap layout
